Wynwood Walls and the arts district.note: Wynwood Walls is an open-air museum of large murals; US freedom of panorama covers building exteriors but not murals or other public art, so a usable photo would need each mural artist's own licence, not just the photographer's. No such doubly-licensed photo was found.

Balloon Museum at Mana Wynwood.note: A temporary traveling exhibition; no Wikimedia Commons photo exists and it is not indexed in Wayfind's inventory, so there is no licensed source of any kind, including Google.

Miami Spice month.note: An annual prix-fixe dining promotion spanning roughly 300 restaurants citywide, not a single visitable place.

Inter Miami at Miami Freedom Park.note: The only Wikimedia Commons photos of Miami Freedom Park show the stadium mid-construction in 2025, not the completed venue the club has now moved into, and the finished stadium is not indexed in Wayfind's inventory; using the construction photo would misrepresent the current place.
